speaker: Doctor
content: Have you ever... looked up at the sky?

raw: [name="Doctor"]Beyond that sky, far beyond the twin moons, there is a place that we would once return to, where we would sleep peacefully.
speaker: Doctor
content: Beyond that sky, far beyond the twin moons, there is a place that we would once return to, where we would sleep peacefully.

raw: [name="Doctor"]But I am the only one left, here speaking with you. In the course of the Sarkaz's eternal search for the remains of dead gods to fend off your enemies, have you ever wondered...?
speaker: Doctor
content: But I am the only one left, here speaking with you. In the course of the Sarkaz's eternal search for the remains of dead gods to fend off your enemies, have you ever wondered...?

speaker: Doctor
content: Why did those gods die?

text: 'In the sea filled with both truth and the unknown, I saw...

text: \n'A fleeting vision of the gods before they died, and root of the pain you bear.'

text: \n'Before I retire to my eternal slumber, I will destroy you. I shall build a ladder for the Sarkaz.'

text: \n'No longer will anyone toy with the fate of the Sarkaz. We shall reclaim our own destiny, {@nickname}.'

content: Theresis swings his sword.

content: A beam of light stings your eyes, and you wrack your brain, trying to recall how to stop Amnannam.

content: Amiya's barrier breaks, layer by layer, amidst the gleam of the sword. You think you see Mon3tr's huge frame blocking your view.

options: STOP!

content: You suddenly remember everything about the moment you almost lost Amiya. You remember how you stopped it all.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="<color=#000000>You did it, Dr. {@nickname}.</color>", x=250,y=340, alignment="center", duration=1, size=24, delay=0.04, width=800)]
text: <color=#000000>You did it, Dr. {@nickname}.</color>

content: You remembered—

options: (...Priestess...);(Priestess!)

speaker: Theresis
content: You—!

[Blocker(a=0.5, r=1, g=0, b=0, afrom=0, rfrom=0, gfrom=0, bfrom=0, fadetime=0.1, block=true)]

speaker: Voice in the Smoke
content: You told us that we would only have one chance to strike.

raw: [name="Voice in the Smoke"]You really have slowed down a lot...
speaker: Voice in the Smoke
content: You really have slowed down a lot...

raw: Theresis struggles to lower his head and sees the blade that has pierced his heart, as well as Ascalon, with a determined look on her face and tears in her eyes.
content: Theresis struggles to lower his head and sees the blade that has pierced his heart, as well as Ascalon, with a determined look on her face and tears in her eyes.

raw: The figure steps out of the smoke and pins Theresis to the throne with all her strength.
content: The figure steps out of the smoke and pins Theresis to the throne with all her strength.

raw: Amnannam and his sword fall to the ground, lying in the shallow water reflecting the dim light.
content: Amnannam and his sword fall to the ground, lying in the shallow water reflecting the dim light.

speaker: Ascalon
content: Master... this is the end.
Theresis raises his hand.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Careful, do not let him touch it again.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Careful, do not let him touch it again.

raw: Theresis clutches Ascalon's assassin blade and uses all his strength to slowly draw it from his chest.
content: Theresis clutches Ascalon's assassin blade and uses all his strength to slowly draw it from his chest.

raw: There is no blood. There is no warmth. All that's left are a few shattered crystal shards.
content: There is no blood. There is no warmth. All that's left are a few shattered crystal shards.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Well done. You've finally found your conviction.
speaker: Theresis
content: Well done. You've finally found your conviction.

speaker: Ascalon
content: ...Your heart...

speaker: Theresis
content: It stopped beating a while ago.

speaker: Theresis
content: I've repaid my debt.

speaker: Theresis
content: Take it...

raw: Theresis, straining, shifts his gaze towards Amnannam laying on the ground.
content: Theresis, straining, shifts his gaze towards Amnannam laying on the ground.

speaker: Theresis
content: Find Manfred...

speaker: Theresis
content: And Kazdel... go home...

speaker: Ascalon
content: You—

raw: Ascalon feels himself being pushed away by a very weak hand.
content: Ascalon feels himself being pushed away by a very weak hand.

speaker: Theresis
content: I will stay here.

raw: [name="Theresis"]I cannot let the Sarkaz know... my fate...
speaker: Theresis
content: I cannot let the Sarkaz know... my fate...

raw: He hears faint cheers from above, the cheers of the Victorians.
content: He hears faint cheers from above, the cheers of the Victorians.

raw: [Decision(options="The Nachzehrer King is gone.;You missed Logos's elegy for the Nachzehrer.", values="1;2")]
options: The Nachzehrer King is gone.;You missed Logos's elegy for the Nachzehrer.

speaker: Theresis
content: His war ended just before mine.

raw: [name="Theresis"]{@nickname}, I was able to gaze upon the true face of the gods.
speaker: Theresis
content: {@nickname}, I was able to gaze upon the true face of the gods.

raw: [name="Theresis"]I only regret that I was unable to completely defeat.... you.
speaker: Theresis
content: I only regret that I was unable to completely defeat.... you.

options: Kal'tsit?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Assuming he speaks the truth, he may have bought Terra a moment's respite.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Assuming he speaks the truth, he may have bought Terra a moment's respite.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Regardless, we must continue our preparations, Doctor.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Regardless, we must continue our preparations, Doctor.

speaker: Amiya
content: Then, Theresis...

raw: [name="Ascalon"]He will remain here. I'll ensure that no one disturbs him, and no one finds him.
speaker: Ascalon
content: He will remain here. I'll ensure that no one disturbs him, and no one finds him.

raw: She holds up Amnannam, and Theresis's sword.
content: She holds up Amnannam, and Theresis's sword.

raw: [name="Ascalon"]Doctor, Dr. Kal'tsit, Amnannam belongs to Kazdel.
speaker: Ascalon
content: Doctor, Dr. Kal'tsit, Amnannam belongs to Kazdel.

speaker: Ascalon
content: It must return to Kazdel.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: We must consider this matter carefully.

raw: [name="Amiya"]The damage the Sarkaz inflicted on Londinium is bound to stir a new wave of hatred—and without proper guidance, it could lead to an even darker nightmare.
speaker: Amiya
content: The damage the Sarkaz inflicted on Londinium is bound to stir a new wave of hatred—and without proper guidance, it could lead to an even darker nightmare.

raw: [name="Amiya"]This war must end, but Kazdel must also take measures to protect itself. We can go to Kazdel together and watch how they use Amnannam.
speaker: Amiya
content: This war must end, but Kazdel must also take measures to protect itself. We can go to Kazdel together and watch how they use Amnannam.

raw: [Decision(options="This really is the best move, Kal'tsit. ", values="1")]
options: This really is the best move, Kal'tsit.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]There are many things we need to discuss, but not here.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: There are many things we need to discuss, but not here.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]First, we must use Amnannam to leave this place. Give it a try, Doctor.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: First, we must use Amnannam to leave this place. Give it a try, Doctor.

raw: [Decision(options="Strange... it's not responding to me.", values="1")]
options: Strange... it's not responding to me.

speaker: Ascalon
content: Let me try. I can feel... a faint connection. I think it's responding to me.

The sealed passage reopens yet again.

speaker: Ascalon
content: Is it assaulting my thoughts?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Enough. We can't just keep using this thing haphazardly. We need to do more research on both its uses and its potential dangers.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Enough. We can't just keep using this thing haphazardly. We need to do more research on both its uses and its potential dangers.

content: Ascalon looks at the figure on the throne. In the darkness, she cannot make out his face.

raw: Her eyes are a bit blurry.
content: Her eyes are a bit blurry.

speaker: Ascalon
content: I'll go with you.

raw: [name="Ascalon"]I will respect his wishes. I don't need to witness his end.
speaker: Ascalon
content: I will respect his wishes. I don't need to witness his end.

speaker: Amiya
content: Ascalon...

The Cautus hugs Ascalon tightly. Ascalon suddenly realizes that the frail Cautus she once found in the wilderness has grown up.
content: The Cautus hugs Ascalon tightly. Ascalon suddenly realizes that the frail Cautus she once found in the wilderness has grown up.

speaker: Amiya
content: Let's go home together.

speaker: Amiya
content: ...Doctor?

raw: [Decision(options="You all go ahead. I'll catch up.", values="1")]
options: You all go ahead. I'll catch up.

speaker: Amiya
content: I'll stay here to protect you—

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Mon3tr is staying here, and it should be sufficient. Theresis is no longer a threat.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Mon3tr is staying here, and it should be sufficient. Theresis is no longer a threat.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: We'll wait for you outside.

content: It's very quiet. All you can hear is dripping water. You silently creep closer to the man on the throne.

speaker: Theresis
content: You do not fear death, {@nickname}?

raw: [Decision(options="You can't kill me.;You don't think that way.", values="1;2")]
options: You can't kill me.;You don't think that way.

speaker: Theresis
content: Yes, that is assuredly true.

raw: [name="Theresis"]That is why you remain here and mock me?
speaker: Theresis
content: That is why you remain here and mock me?

speaker: Theresis
content: Haha——*cough* Haha...

speaker: Theresis
content: Such a prideful stance.
His voice is hoarse.

raw: [Decision(options="You're forcing yourself to speak with me.", values="1")]
options: You're forcing yourself to speak with me.

speaker: Theresis
content: You have won my respect, {@nickname}.

speaker: Theresis
content: You're more determined than I thought.

raw: [name="Theresis"]But you are on... a suicide mission.
speaker: Theresis
content: But you are on... a suicide mission.

raw: [Decision(options="I never imagined you could seize Amnannam.", values="1")]
options: I never imagined you could seize Amnannam.

raw: [Decision(options="You are heroes, in the eyes of the Sarkaz, but—", values="1")]
options: You are heroes, in the eyes of the Sarkaz, but—

speaker: Theresis
content: *cough* Hahaha...

options: Why are you laughing?

content: I'm laughing at you, {@nickname}.

speaker: Theresis
content: You... know nothing.

raw: [Decision(options="What did you find in the Assimilated Universe?", values="1")]
options: What did you find in the Assimilated Universe?

raw: [name="Theresis"]That is my secret. You have no right to ask.
speaker: Theresis
content: That is my secret. You have no right to ask.

speaker: Theresis
content: I have no desire to belittle Rhodes Island's yearning to heal the wounds caused by Originium.

content: Yet it is still so ironic, hahaha—

speaker: Theresis
content: In the end, if you find that the real monster… is you—

speaker: Theresis
content: Then what will you do, {@nickname}?

options: —?!;What have you learned?

speaker: Theresis
content: *cough* Alas, I will not live to see that day. You and I never really did get along.

raw: [name="Theresis"]It was so then, as it is now.
speaker: Theresis
content: It was so then, as it is now.

content: He grabs at his clothing. It seems like he's trying to find something.

raw: There are deep cuts on his breastplate, wounds left by Ascalon.
content: There are deep cuts on his breastplate, wounds left by Ascalon.

content: He finally finds what he's looking for—the stone blade he always carries.

content: (Warning roar)

content: Calm down... monster of Kal'tsit.

He's just trying to throw you the blade.

speaker: Theresis
content: It's Ascalon's.

speaker: Theresis
content: Leave.

raw: [name="Theresis"]You are not worthy of witnessing my end.
speaker: Theresis
content: You are not worthy of witnessing my end.

content: His consciousness comes to rest beside a lonely monster.

content: The ugly Teekaz, wearing a black crown on his head, walks out from the silvery mountains. He looks up at the vast starry sky.

content: The eternal starry sky. The wild, primal continent. From every corner of existence, countless lives look beyond the earth and stars—they all gaze up at the same universe.

content: He's not lonely. He feels more calm and peaceful than he's ever felt in his life.

raw: [name="Theresis"]At last, I see the past, as you once saw it...
speaker: Theresis
content: At last, I see the past, as you once saw it...

content: As well as the future.

content: He wants to say something more, to call that name one last time, but he can no longer speak.

content: He's totally exhausted, but as he prepares to close his eyes, a faint white ray emerges from the darkness.

speaker: Familiar Gentle Voice
content: 'Our time has finally come to an end.'

content: 'Goodbye, Theresis.'

text: 'And then... disintegration... death... but, why?'

content: (Unknown language) In any case, welcome.

content: (Unknown language) Come. Seek me.
